### Jesus’ First and Last Words
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-january-31-2026.html
Passage: Matthew 28:18-19
Points:
- Jesus' earliest and final earthly instructions both center on sharing the Good News with others.
- Truly following Jesus teaches believers to care about bringing people into God's family.
- Because Jesus holds all authority as Creator, He authorizes His followers to serve as His agents.
- Faithfully pointing others to Christ allows believers to help lead people to eternal salvation.

### What Does Matthew 28:18–20 Mean?
Author: Aaron Garriott
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/what-does-matthew-28-mean
Passage: Matthew 28:18-20
Points:
- The Great Commission fulfills the ancient prophetic promise that all nations would belong to God.
- Jesus' ascension is not His retirement; He continues gathering His harvest through the church.
- The commission is carried out through ordinary means of grace, discipleship, and everyday faithfulness.
- Every believer in any vocation is an authorized laborer sustained by Christ's abiding presence.
